claim_under_test: A legacy hosted bundle that predates verification-authority binding cannot be accepted by the current service callback merely by omission, relabelling, or binding it to another claim locator.
cases: untouched legacy bundle with no verification authority
legacy bundle relabelled auto_planned without authority evidence
legacy bundle relabelled auto_planned with the other archived claim locator digest
structural control with auto_planned and its own exact locator digest
kill_criteria: any missing-authority legacy bundle is accepted
any label-only or cross-locator mutation is accepted
measurement or provisional comparison is erased
a legacy result is described as independently authorized without contemporaneous evidence
bounded_interpretation: The exact-binding control tests current callback structure only. It does not retroactively establish that the archived workflow had independent authority.
